title: Algebra recap: notation and substitution
learning_objectives: Read and write algebraic notation; substitute values into expressions
key_content: 3x means 3 × x; substitution into 2x + 5 for x = 4; negative substitution

title: Two-step equations the quick way
learning_objectives: Solve two-step equations using 'change side, change sign'
key_content: 3x + 4 = 19: move the 4 across (it becomes −4), then divide
teaching_approach: 'Change side, change sign' taught as the rule; we do not use the balance method in this class

title: Simplifying expressions
learning_objectives: Collect like terms, including with negative coefficients
key_content: Collect the x terms and the numbers; 7x − 3 + 2x + 8

title: Equations with x on both sides
learning_objectives: Solve equations with the unknown on both sides using 'change side, change sign'
key_content: 5x + 3 = 2x + 12: move the 2x across (it becomes −2x), move the 3 across (it becomes −3)
teaching_approach: 'Change side, change sign' for both the x-term and the number. Emphasise that the sign changes every time a term crosses

title: Equations with brackets
learning_objectives: Expand a bracket and then solve using 'change side, change sign'
key_content: Expand 3(x + 2) = 21 to 3x + 6 = 21, then move the 6 across
teaching_approach: Expand first, then the usual rule

title: Equations with fractions
learning_objectives: Solve equations with a fractional coefficient or a fraction on one side
teaching_approach: Multiply both sides by the denominator, then 'change side, change sign'
